Video converter for Shadertoy
Copyright (C) Asger Andersen

THIRD-PARTY SOFTWARE NOTICE: FFmpeg

This program uses code from the FFmpeg project (https://ffmpeg.org), version 8.1.3
(release tag n8.1.3). The libraries used are libavcodec, libavformat, libavutil,
libswscale and libswresample.

FFmpeg is a trademark of Fabrice Bellard, originator of the FFmpeg project.

License
-------

The FFmpeg libraries used by this program are licensed under the GNU Lesser General
Public License (LGPL) version 2.1 or later. The full license texts are provided in this
folder:

    COPYING.LGPLv2.1
    COPYING.LGPLv3
    FFmpeg-LICENSE.md

FFmpeg is configured without --enable-gpl, without --enable-nonfree and without
--enable-version3. No GPL or non-free component and no external encoder library
(such as libx264) is included. H.264 encoding uses the Windows Media Foundation
encoder (h264_mf) that is part of Windows.

Components enabled in this build
--------------------------------

    Video encoder      h264_mf (Windows Media Foundation)
    Audio encoder      aac (native FFmpeg AAC encoder)
    Audio decoder      mp3float (native FFmpeg MP3 decoder)
    Demuxer            mp3
    Muxer              mp4
    Parser             mpegaudio
    Protocol           file
    Conversion         libswscale (RGB to YUV), libswresample

The exact configuration is defined in tools/ffmpeg_config.sh.

Source code
-----------

The complete FFmpeg source code used to build this program is provided unmodified in
the folder third_party/ffmpeg/src of the source distribution of this program. It is
the code of the FFmpeg release n8.1.3, reduced to the libraries listed above and to the
build system files needed to compile them.

Replacing the FFmpeg libraries
------------------------------

FFmpeg is linked statically. To use a modified or different version of FFmpeg:

    1. Replace the content of third_party/ffmpeg/src with the desired FFmpeg source.
    2. Run tools/build_ffmpeg.ps1 (requires Visual Studio 2022, MSYS2 and nasm).
       This produces third_party/ffmpeg/x64/lib/*.lib and third_party/ffmpeg/x64/include.
    3. Rebuild VideoConverterForShadertoy.sln. The program is relinked with the new
       libraries.

The source distribution of this program contains everything needed to rebuild and
relink the program.
